summary.ja: Bratu方程式のパラメータ感度で、陰関数の感度方程式・離散随伴勾配・解析的な連続感度・解き直した有限差分を検証する。
summary.en: Verify implicit state sensitivities and discrete-adjoint gradients on Bratu against analytic continuous sensitivities and finite differences with fresh nonlinear solves.

assumptions: Smooth residual and scalar objective; locally nonsingular state Jacobian.
Fixed mesh and boundary data independent of the parameter; lower-branch Bratu at alpha=1 and alpha=2.
Converged discrete equations are differentiated; finite Newton iterations are not unrolled.
units: Dimensionless Bratu variables and parameter; objective quadrature h=1/(n+1) is explicit.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(1)=0 on [0,1], fixed independently of lambda; corresponding boundary sensitivity is zero.

next_deliverable.ja: 時間依存の随伴、複数観測の逆問題最適化、非滑らかな問題への独立した検証。
next_deliverable.en: Separate verification for time-dependent adjoints, inverse optimization with multiple observations and nonsmooth problems.

limitations.ja: 滑らかなBratu下側分枝と非対称の小規模線形例による教育用検証。離散随伴はEuclid内積で定義し、目的関数の積分重みを明記する。逆問題の最適化や時間依存随伴、衝撃波感度は実装しない。
limitations.en: Educational verification on the smooth Bratu lower branch and a small nonsymmetric linear example. The discrete adjoint uses the Euclidean pairing with objective quadrature weights explicit. Inverse optimization, time-dependent adjoints and shock sensitivities are not implemented.

metadata_review.level: implicit and discrete-adjoint implementation; analytic, re-solved finite-difference and spatial-refinement checks

code_mapping_scope: Separate immutable Bratu sensitivity supplement. General multi-parameter linear sensitivity and transpose adjoint solves; original Bratu residual and zero-start damped Newton, AD residual derivatives, analytic family reference, nonlinear parameter perturbations and a nonsymmetric manufactured check.
assumptions_ja: 滑らかな残差とスカラー目的関数を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。
格子と境界値はパラメータに依存しない。Bratuの下側分枝のalpha=1、2を使う。
収束した離散方程式を微分し、有限回のNewton反復は展開して微分しない。
boundary_conditions_ja: 区間[0,1]でu(0)=u(1)=0をlambdaに依存せず固定し、境界の感度はゼロとする。
units_ja: Bratuの変数とパラメータは無次元。目的関数の求積重みh=1/(n+1)を明記する。
